title.narrative: Enhanced Food and Nutrition Security for Vulnerable People in Flood-affected Areas of Pakistan

description.narrative: The overall objective of the proposed action is to support and bring stability to the most vulnerable flood-affected households in the worst-affected districts of Pakistan to facilitate their early recovery, rehabilitation and reconstruction with a focus on conflict prevention and social cohesion, in line with the Humanitarian-Development-Peace Triple Nexus.
